# Contentful Graphql

The Contentful GraphQL Content API allows developers to query and deliver content using GraphQL, providing a flexible and efficient way to access content stored in Contentful.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/contentful-graphql/.

## Actions

- **GraphQL Content API Persisted Query** (read-only): Execute a persisted GraphQL query via its SHA256 hash.
- **GraphQL Content API Query** (read-only): Execute a GraphQL query against a specified space and environment.
- **Get CMA Token**: Retrieve a Contentful Management API (CMA) access token.
